question: R Muthukannammal was awarded the Padma Shri 2022 for which of the following dance styles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sadir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R Muthukannammal:-**

 
 
• He was a renowned exponent of Bharatanatyam, a classical dance form of India. 
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri:-**
 
 
• It is the fourth highest civilian award in India
 
• It is awarded for exceptional contributions in various fields including arts, literature, and social work.
 
 
 
• **Sadir:**
 
 
• A precursor to Bharatanatyam, practiced mainly in Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya****: **

 
 
• A traditional dance form of Assam.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam: **
 
 
• A classical dance form of Kerala, characterized by graceful movements and facial expressions.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali: **
 
 
• A classical dance-drama form of Kerala, known for its elaborate costumes and makeup.
